issues.on_page: Reclassifications: Regular instruction (45,203.38); Special education school age (42,637.42)
issues.issue: The amounts are correct (-45,203.38 and -42,637.42). But both contra lines carry the formula for the combined -87,840.80 instead of their own single figure. This is a cosmetic description error; detail[37].computed has the same problem.

issues.on_page: Exh D Other Governmental Funds: Regular instruction 90,436.75 + Support services SPED school age 127,927.26 (p4)
issues.issue: Exh D puts 127,927.26 of the Cooperative fund's spending under support services. The object lines can't be split by function, so all of it is booked as instruction, and the detail function split doesn't tie to the statement. Judgment call.

issues.on_page: Exh D Contributions and donations 23,314.20 (Other Governmental Funds, p4)
issues.issue: Exh D shows 23,314.20 of the Activities fund's receipts as contributions and donations. The per-account schedule can't separate them, so detail revenue has no donations line for this fund. Disclosed in notes.

issues.on_page: Other Purchased Services 45,327.22 (Occupational Therapy - SPED School Age)

In the school chart of accounts this object also covers insurance, communication, travel and tuition. Fiscal Services 11,351.84 (detail[119]) and Operation of Buildings 30,460.00 (detail[125]) may be insurance. Judgment call.

issues.on_page: School Nutrition fund reported within Other Governmental Funds (p3-p4)
issues.issue: The extractor rules list school nutrition as an example of a business-type fund. Here the report presents it as a governmental (special revenue) fund inside the Total Governmental Funds column, so keeping it governmental matches the statement and its totals. Noted for consistency with other reports.
